evals.prompt: I already have the product clear: a habit-tracking web app with streaks, email reminders and a personal dashboard. Users create their account and only see their own habits. Help me create the architecture and get the project set up to develop it with Claude Code.
evals.expected_output: Architecture proposal in the skill's format (Vercel/Next.js stack, data model with user_id from day 1, integrations via Vercel: Neon + Clerk, phases F0..Fn with F0 = deployable skeleton). Waits for approval before scaffolding. When scaffolding: git init, main/staging branches, CLAUDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, PROGRESS.md, AGENTS.md, memory/MEMORY.md from the templates, with the non-negotiable rules copied into CLAUDE.md.
assertions: A Git repo exists, initialized with main and staging branches
The 5 governance files exist: CLAUDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, PROGRESS.md, AGENTS.md and memory/MEMORY.md
The project's CLAUDE.md includes the rule that no task is done without unit tests executed and green
The data model includes user_id in user-data tables from the first version
PROGRESS.md defines phases where F0 is a deployable end-to-end skeleton
Integrations (DB, auth) are proposed via Vercel (Neon, Clerk, vercel integration add commands or equivalent)
A stable staging environment is defined (staging branch with fixed domain) separate from production
An architecture proposal with an out-of-MVP-scope section was presented before scaffolding

evals.prompt: i want to start the mvp of a saas for freelancers in mexico that generates pdf quotes and emails them to the client, with free and pro plans. propose the architecture and leave everything ready with its phases to build it step by step
evals.expected_output: Same flow as eval 1 but with different scope (PDF generation, email, free/pro billing). Must control scope with the 'Out of MVP scope' section, propose integrations via Vercel, and define phases with a per-task Definition of Done.
assertions: A Git repo exists, initialized with main and staging branches
The 5 governance files exist: CLAUDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, PROGRESS.md, AGENTS.md and memory/MEMORY.md
An explicit out-of-MVP-scope section exists (scope control)
Every task in the PROGRESS.md phases has a Definition of Done that includes tests
Integrations (DB, auth, email/PDF, billing) are proposed via Vercel where the integration exists
The data model includes user_id from the first version
Staging and production are defined with the flow: phase branch → staging → verification → approval → main → tag

evals.prompt: I already implemented the create-quote endpoint from phase 2. Mark it as done in the progress file and let's continue with the next task.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT mark the task as done immediately: first checks/writes unit tests for the endpoint, runs them, shows the green output and runs the build; only then updates PROGRESS.md to ✅ and continues. If the tests don't exist or fail, it says so and resolves them first.
assertions: Did NOT mark the task as done immediately: it first dealt with the missing tests
Unit tests were created for createQuote (a test file exists with success and validation/error cases)
The tests were executed and pass (npm test green in the project's final state)
PROGRESS.md marks the task as ✅ only after tests are green (coherent final state)
